Petitioner Mr. S. Mohanty, Adv. -versus- Secretary, Odisha Staff ... Opp. Parties Selection Commissioner(OSSC), Mr. S.N. Pattanaik, Adv. Bbsr and Another Coram:
texts.arguments: 4.
